stem: A local health district is planning a community burn-prevention campaign for young families; which setting should be prioritised because it accounts for most burns?
explanation: The home is the correct answer because most burns occur there, so home-focused prevention should be prioritised.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Correct because most burns occur at home, making it the highest-yield setting for prevention.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because school playgrounds are not the main setting where most burns occur.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because public swimming pools are not identified as the predominant location for burns.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because sporting clubs are not the setting accounting for most burns.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because hospital waiting rooms are not the principal setting for burn injuries.
